[SWS_DM_00393] Retrieving data for internal DiagnosticDataEle- ments
⌈
If DM requires to provide or store data configured as internal Diagnos-
ticDataElement which is supported by the Diagnostic Server instance ac-
cording to Table 7.4, then DM shall use the respective internally managed data value as
defined in Table 7.4.
